title: CUBE Error v1
description: A failure, recorded instead of hidden. Used by agents (in an Agent Output) and by the orchestrator (in Workflow State).

code.description: Short snake_case code. Standard codes: agent_unavailable, agent_timeout, agent_rejected, agent_exception, invalid_output, tenant_mismatch, model_error, rule_unavailable, upstream_missing.

retryable.description: Would trying again plausibly help? Refusals (4xx, wrong tenant) are not retryable.
